title: Video Lecturing in Clicker-assisted English Flipped Class
author: Zhonggen Yu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7sjhncn
materials: The teaching process assisted with Clicker system
The teaching process for both cohorts

steps.title: Select and Assign Participants
steps.instruction: Recruit 87 Chinese undergraduates (Male N = 43, Female N = 44, aged 19-22) with 8-9 years of formal English education. Randomly assign them into two cohorts: a video-clicker-assisted flipped English class (N = 41) and a non-video-clicker-assisted flipped English class (N = 46).

steps.title: Conduct Baseline Assessments
steps.instruction: Determine pre-test English proficiency and levels of interaction, self-efficacy, and self-regulation for all participants.

substeps.instruction: Administer the CET 4 (June 2012) to identify English proficiency.
Administer interaction, self-efficacy, and self-regulation scales.

steps.title: Implement Flipped Classroom Preparation
steps.instruction: Assign pre-class preparation materials based on the cohort group.

substeps.instruction: Non-video-assisted cohort: Read textbooks before class without video access.
Video-assisted cohort: Access both textbooks and teaching videos (10 to 50 minutes in length) via a communicative platform.

steps.title: Execute Clicker-Assisted Instruction
steps.instruction: Conduct English reading courses over two semesters using a Clicker system for both cohorts.

substeps.instruction: Project language notes on a large screen for students to follow.
Pose questions to the class for students to answer using keyboard controllers.
Transmit answers via wireless receiver and display them as histograms on the large screen.
Adjust teaching progress based on accuracy: if >80% are correct, move on after correcting errors; if ~50% are correct, stop to explain in detail; if most are wrong, repeat the teaching process.

steps.title: Manage Video-Assisted Intervention
steps.instruction: For the intervention cohort, integrate specific video-based requirements to ensure engagement.

substeps.instruction: Require students to download videos from the online space (activities are automatically recorded).
Design quizzes or tests based on video content to be completed in physical and virtual classes.

steps.title: Perform Post-Intervention Evaluation
steps.instruction: After two academic semesters, re-test both cohorts to measure changes in proficiency and psychological scales.

substeps.instruction: Administer the CET 4, which includes: Writing (short essay, min 120 words, 30m), Reading Comprehension (Lexical understanding 40m, Skimming/Scanning 40m, Detailed reading 40m), and Translation (Chinese to English, 30m).
Administer the interaction, self-efficacy, and self-regulation scales using a 5-point Likert scale (1=strongly disagree to 5=strongly agree).

Conduct semi-structured interviews consisting of three sections: demographic information, specific questions on interaction (2-3), self-efficacy (3-4), and self-regulation (2-3), and an acknowledgement section.
